values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 3 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are permitted on campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. Two vehicles per site; boats and boat trailers go to overflow parking.

If you make your reservation within 3 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay'; LENGTH OF STAY; 'All boats and boat trailers must park in overflow parking'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every campsite has electric: 79 at 30 A, 22 at 50 A. No full-hookup sites.

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica, 2027 season May 14-Oct 10 (2026: May 15-Oct 11), every site electric. Added 9-month window, same-day/walk-ins, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, 50 A (22 sites), 101 sites to 40 ft (back-in), showers, dump, water fill. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. AWH note kept. Not stated: water/sewer at sites, pull-throughs.
